title: The Food Lab Chocolate Chip Cookies
description: Browned butter chocolate chip cookies inspired by The Food Lab, featuring a scientific approach for deep flavor and perfect texture.

steps.instruction: Brown butter in a saucepan over medium-high heat until golden and nutty, about 5 minutes.
Remove from heat, whisk in ice cube, and cool completely (about 20 minutes).
Whisk together flour, baking soda, and salt in a bowl.
Whisk eggs, granulated sugar, and vanilla in a mixer until pale and thick, about 5 minutes.
Add cooled brown butter and brown sugar to egg mixture and mix briefly to combine.
Add dry ingredients and mix until just combined.
Chill dough overnight (or at least a few hours) for best results.
Preheat oven to 325°F and portion dough into 3-tablespoon balls.
Bake 13–16 minutes until edges are golden but centers are soft.
Sprinkle with sea salt while warm and let cool before serving.
